name: comp-549
blurb: Vertical list upload for multiple files with details and progress.
description: Multi-file uploader in list format showing file names, sizes, and upload progress. Each file has individual remove control.
use_when: Bulk document uploads, file management interfaces, or detailed progress tracking.
avoid_when: Quick image galleries; use grid layout instead.
a11y: List items are accessible. Progress announcements via live region.
